summary: The hub: a village round a trodden square, an oak of carved faces, a clocktower, the Silverbell along the south and the crooked estate on its hill.
text: Timber-framed houses with steep roofs crowd round a trodden square where a faceless statue stands on one side and a gnarled oak, bark carved all over with faces, on the other. A clocktower rises over the village and the river runs dark along its southern edge.
